dishes.name: Bruschetta Classica
dishes.description_en: Toasted rustic bread with marinated tomatoes, basil, and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.
dishes.description_es: Pan rústico tostado con tomates marinados, albahaca y un chorrito de aceite de oliva virgen extra.
dishes.story_en: Our bread is baked every morning, grilled over the flame and rubbed with garlic, then topped with ripe tomatoes marinated in olive oil and torn basil. A Tuscan farmhouse classic.
dishes.story_es: Nuestro pan se hornea cada mañana, se tuesta a la llama y se frota con ajo; luego lo cubrimos con tomates maduros marinados en aceite de oliva y albahaca fresca. Un clásico de las granjas de la Toscana.

dishes.name: Carpaccio di Manzo
dishes.description_en: Thinly sliced beef tenderloin with arugula, parmesan shavings, and truffle oil.
dishes.description_es: Finas láminas de solomillo de res con rúcula, lascas de parmesano y aceite de trufa.
dishes.story_en: Prime beef tenderloin, chilled and sliced paper-thin, dressed with lemon, peppery rocket, aged Parmigiano Reggiano and a few drops of black truffle oil. The dish was created in Venice in 1950.
dishes.story_es: Solomillo de res de primera, frío y cortado finísimo, aliñado con limón, rúcula, Parmigiano Reggiano añejo y unas gotas de aceite de trufa negra. Este plato nació en Venecia en 1950.

dishes.name: Arancini Siciliani
dishes.description_en: Golden risotto croquettes filled with mozzarella and herbs.
dishes.description_es: Croquetas doradas de risotto rellenas de mozzarella y hierbas.
dishes.story_en: Sicily’s favourite street food: saffron risotto shaped by hand around a heart of melting mozzarella, rolled in breadcrumbs and fried until golden.
dishes.story_es: La comida callejera favorita de Sicilia: risotto de azafrán formado a mano alrededor de un corazón de mozzarella fundida, rebozado en pan rallado y frito hasta dorarse.

dishes.name: Caprese Elegante
dishes.description_en: Fresh buffalo mozzarella layered with heirloom tomatoes and basil, finished with balsamic pearls.
dishes.description_es: Mozzarella de búfala fresca con tomates tradicionales y albahaca, terminada con perlas de balsámico.
dishes.story_en: A tribute to the island of Capri in the colours of the Italian flag: creamy buffalo mozzarella from Campania, heirloom tomatoes and basil, finished with pearls of aged balsamic from Modena.
dishes.story_es: Un homenaje a la isla de Capri con los colores de la bandera italiana: mozzarella de búfala de Campania, tomates tradicionales y albahaca, con perlas de balsámico añejo de Módena.

dishes.name: Antipasto Aurea
dishes.description_en: A curated selection of Italian cured meats, artisanal cheeses, and olives.
dishes.description_es: Una selección de embutidos italianos, quesos artesanales y aceitunas.
dishes.story_en: A sharing board for the table: prosciutto di Parma, salame and mortadella, aged pecorino and gorgonzola, marinated olives and crisp grissini.
dishes.story_es: Una tabla para compartir: prosciutto di Parma, salame y mortadela, pecorino añejo y gorgonzola, aceitunas marinadas y grissini crujientes.

dishes.name: Frittura di Calamari
dishes.description_en: Lightly fried calamari with lemon aioli and fresh herbs.
dishes.description_es: Calamares ligeramente fritos con alioli de limón y hierbas frescas.
dishes.story_en: Tender squid dusted in seasoned flour and fried in seconds so it stays light and crisp, served the Neapolitan way with lemon and a garlicky lemon aioli.
dishes.story_es: Calamar tierno pasado por harina sazonada y frito en segundos para que quede ligero y crujiente, servido al estilo napolitano con limón y alioli de limón.

dishes.name: Tagliatelle Bolognese
dishes.description_en: Fresh ribbon pasta with a slow-cooked beef ragù.
dishes.description_es: Pasta fresca en cintas con ragú de res cocinado a fuego lento.
dishes.story_en: Our ragù simmers for four hours with beef, pork, vegetables, red wine and a splash of milk, just like in Bologna. Tossed with egg tagliatelle rolled by hand every morning.
dishes.story_es: Nuestro ragú se cocina cuatro horas con res, cerdo, verduras, vino tinto y un chorrito de leche, como en Bolonia. Lo servimos con tagliatelle de huevo hechos a mano cada mañana.

dishes.name: Risotto al Tartufo
dishes.description_en: Creamy arborio rice infused with black truffle and parmesan.
dishes.description_es: Cremoso arroz arborio con trufa negra y parmesano.
dishes.story_en: Arborio rice stirred slowly with white wine and vegetable stock, finished with butter, Parmigiano and shavings of black truffle. Patience in a bowl.
dishes.story_es: Arroz arborio removido lentamente con vino blanco y caldo de verduras, terminado con mantequilla, Parmigiano y láminas de trufa negra. Paciencia en un plato.

dishes.name: Sea Bass alla Griglia
dishes.description_en: Grilled Mediterranean sea bass with lemon butter and roasted fennel.
dishes.description_es: Lubina mediterránea a la parrilla con mantequilla de limón e hinojo asado.
dishes.story_en: Mediterranean sea bass grilled skin-side down until crisp, with lemon butter and fennel roasted until sweet and caramelised.
dishes.story_es: Lubina mediterránea a la parrilla por el lado de la piel hasta que queda crujiente, con mantequilla de limón e hinojo asado hasta caramelizarse.

dishes.name: Pollo alla Parmigiana
dishes.description_en: Breaded chicken breast with mozzarella, parmesan, and a light tomato sauce.
dishes.description_es: Pechuga de pollo empanizada con mozzarella, parmesano y una ligera salsa de tomate.
dishes.story_en: Chicken breast pounded thin, breaded and pan-fried, then baked under tomato sauce, mozzarella and Parmigiano until bubbling. Comfort food from southern Italy.
dishes.story_es: Pechuga de pollo aplanada, empanizada y dorada, luego horneada con salsa de tomate, mozzarella y Parmigiano hasta gratinar. Comida reconfortante del sur de Italia.

dishes.name: Osso Buco Milanese
dishes.description_en: Braised veal shank with saffron risotto and gremolata.
dishes.description_es: Jarrete de ternera estofado con risotto de azafrán y gremolata.
dishes.story_en: Veal shank braised slowly in white wine and vegetables until it falls from the bone, served with saffron risotto and a fresh gremolata of lemon zest, parsley and garlic.
dishes.story_es: Jarrete de ternera estofado lentamente en vino blanco y verduras hasta que se desprende del hueso, con risotto de azafrán y gremolata fresca de limón, perejil y ajo.

dishes.name: Linguine ai Frutti di Mare
dishes.description_en: Pasta with clams, mussels, shrimp, and calamari in a white wine sauce.
dishes.description_es: Pasta con almejas, mejillones, camarones y calamares en salsa de vino blanco.
dishes.story_en: Linguine tossed with clams, mussels, prawns and squid in white wine, garlic, chilli and parsley: the taste of a summer evening on the Amalfi coast.
dishes.story_es: Linguine con almejas, mejillones, camarones y calamares en vino blanco, ajo, guindilla y perejil: el sabor de una tarde de verano en la costa de Amalfi.

dishes.name: Tiramisu Classico
dishes.description_en: Layers of espresso-soaked ladyfingers with mascarpone cream and cocoa.
dishes.description_es: Capas de bizcochos bañados en espresso con crema de mascarpone y cacao.
dishes.story_en: Savoiardi biscuits dipped in fresh espresso, layered with whipped mascarpone, rested overnight and dusted with cocoa. Its name means “pick me up”.
dishes.story_es: Bizcochos savoiardi mojados en espresso, en capas con crema de mascarpone, reposados toda la noche y espolvoreados con cacao. Su nombre significa “levántame el ánimo”.

dishes.name: Panna Cotta alla Vaniglia
dishes.description_en: Silky vanilla cream topped with a wild berry coulis.
dishes.description_es: Suave crema de vainilla con coulis de frutos rojos.
dishes.story_en: “Cooked cream” from Piedmont: cream gently set with real vanilla, with a sharp coulis of wild berries.
dishes.story_es: “Nata cocida” del Piamonte: crema cuajada suavemente con vainilla natural, con un coulis ácido de frutos rojos.

dishes.name: Cannoli Siciliani
dishes.description_en: Crisp pastry shells filled with ricotta cream and candied orange.
dishes.description_es: Crujientes canutillos rellenos de crema de ricotta y naranja confitada.
dishes.story_en: Crisp pastry tubes filled to order, so they never go soft, with sweet ricotta, candied orange and a sprinkle of pistachio.
dishes.story_es: Canutillos crujientes rellenos al momento, para que nunca se ablanden, con ricotta dulce, naranja confitada y un toque de pistacho.

dishes.name: Affogato al Caffè
dishes.description_en: Vanilla gelato drowned in hot espresso.
dishes.description_es: Helado de vainilla bañado en espresso caliente.
dishes.story_en: Simple and perfect: a scoop of vanilla gelato “drowned” at the table in a shot of hot espresso.
dishes.story_es: Sencillo y perfecto: una bola de helado de vainilla “ahogada” en la mesa con un espresso caliente.

dishes.name: Torta Caprese
dishes.description_en: Flourless chocolate and almond cake with powdered sugar.
dishes.description_es: Torta de chocolate y almendras sin harina, con azúcar glas.
dishes.story_en: Born by happy accident in Capri when a baker forgot the flour: a rich, fudgy cake of dark chocolate and ground almonds.
dishes.story_es: Nació por un feliz accidente en Capri, cuando un pastelero olvidó la harina: una torta densa y jugosa de chocolate negro y almendra molida.

dishes.name: Gelato Artigianale
dishes.description_en: Chef’s selection of artisanal Italian gelato flavors.
dishes.description_es: Selección del chef de helados artesanales italianos.
dishes.story_en: Three scoops from our daily selection, churned in small batches. Ask for today’s flavours; pistachio and stracciatella are guest favourites.
dishes.story_es: Tres bolas de nuestra selección del día, hechas en pequeñas tandas. Pregunta por los sabores de hoy; el pistacho y la stracciatella son los favoritos.

dishes.name: Focaccia al Rosmarino
dishes.description_en: Warm rosemary focaccia with olive oil.
dishes.description_es: Focaccia tibia de romero con aceite de oliva.
dishes.story_en: Light, airy Ligurian focaccia, dimpled by hand, soaked with olive oil and baked with rosemary and sea salt.
dishes.story_es: Focaccia ligur ligera y esponjosa, marcada a mano, bañada en aceite de oliva y horneada con romero y sal marina.

dishes.name: Patate al Tartufo
dishes.description_en: Truffle-dusted potato wedges.
dishes.description_es: Gajos de papa con polvo de trufa.
dishes.story_en: Potato wedges roasted until crisp, then tossed with truffle salt and fresh herbs.
dishes.story_es: Gajos de papa asados hasta quedar crujientes, con sal de trufa y hierbas frescas.

dishes.name: Verdure Grigliate
dishes.description_en: Grilled seasonal vegetables.
dishes.description_es: Verduras de temporada a la parrilla.
dishes.story_en: Courgette, aubergine, peppers and red onion, chargrilled and dressed with olive oil, garlic and fresh herbs.
dishes.story_es: Calabacín, berenjena, pimientos y cebolla morada a la brasa, aliñados con aceite de oliva, ajo y hierbas frescas.

dishes.name: Polenta Cremosa
dishes.description_en: Creamy parmesan polenta.
dishes.description_es: Polenta cremosa con parmesano.
dishes.story_en: Golden cornmeal cooked slowly and finished with butter and Parmigiano, a northern Italian classic.
dishes.story_es: Harina de maíz cocinada lentamente y terminada con mantequilla y Parmigiano, un clásico del norte de Italia.

dishes.name: Funghi Trifolati
dishes.description_en: Sautéed mushrooms with garlic, parsley, and olive oil.
dishes.description_es: Champiñones salteados con ajo, perejil y aceite de oliva.
dishes.story_en: Mushrooms sautéed in olive oil with garlic and parsley. “Trifolati” means cooked the way you would cook truffles.
dishes.story_es: Champiñones salteados en aceite de oliva con ajo y perejil. “Trifolati” significa cocinados como se cocina la trufa.

dishes.name: Pane della Casa
dishes.description_en: Assorted house bread with dipping oils.
dishes.description_es: Surtido de panes de la casa con aceites para mojar.
dishes.story_en: A basket of our breads baked that morning, with extra virgin olive oil and aged balsamic for dipping.
dishes.story_es: Una cesta de nuestros panes horneados esa misma mañana, con aceite de oliva virgen extra y balsámico añejo para mojar.

dishes.name: Prosecco di Valdobbiadene
dishes.description_en: Sparkling, crisp, refreshing.
dishes.description_es: Espumoso, fresco y refrescante.
dishes.story_en: From the hills of Valdobbiadene in the Veneto: fine bubbles with notes of green apple and white flowers. The perfect start to a meal.
dishes.story_es: De las colinas de Valdobbiadene, en el Véneto: burbuja fina con notas de manzana verde y flores blancas. El comienzo perfecto.

dishes.name: Pinot Grigio delle Venezie
dishes.description_en: Classic light Italian white.
dishes.description_es: Clásico vino blanco italiano, ligero.
dishes.story_en: Fresh and dry, with hints of pear and citrus. A lovely match for seafood and light pasta.
dishes.story_es: Fresco y seco, con notas de pera y cítricos. Ideal con mariscos y pastas ligeras.

dishes.name: Chianti Classico Riserva
dishes.description_en: Robust Tuscan red.
dishes.description_es: Tinto toscano con cuerpo.
dishes.story_en: Sangiovese from the heart of Tuscany, aged at least two years: cherry, leather and spice. Made for our ragù and grilled meats.
dishes.story_es: Sangiovese del corazón de la Toscana, con al menos dos años de crianza: cereza, cuero y especias. Hecho para nuestro ragú y las carnes a la parrilla.

dishes.name: Barolo DOCG
dishes.description_en: The “King of Wines” from Piedmont.
dishes.description_es: El “Rey de los vinos” del Piamonte.
dishes.story_en: Nebbiolo from Piedmont, aged at least three years. Powerful and elegant, with notes of roses and dark cherry.
dishes.story_es: Nebbiolo del Piamonte, con al menos tres años de crianza. Potente y elegante, con notas de rosas y cereza negra.

dishes.name: Amaro Averna
dishes.description_en: Traditional Sicilian digestif.
dishes.description_es: Digestivo tradicional siciliano.
dishes.story_en: A Sicilian herbal liqueur made since 1868, bittersweet with orange, liquorice and herbs. Served after dinner.
dishes.story_es: Licor siciliano de hierbas elaborado desde 1868, agridulce, con naranja, regaliz y hierbas. Se sirve después de cenar.

dishes.name: Limoncello di Sorrento
dishes.description_en: Iconic lemon liqueur from the Amalfi coast.
dishes.description_es: El icónico licor de limón de la costa de Amalfi.
dishes.story_en: Made by steeping Sorrento lemon peel in alcohol and sugar. Served ice-cold to finish the meal.
dishes.story_es: Elaborado macerando cáscara de limón de Sorrento en alcohol y azúcar. Se sirve muy frío para terminar la comida.
